overview.lectura: El nucleo del nicho ya tiene dueno, pero al lado hay un pedazo grande de demanda sin pelear. La entrada no es la keyword principal: es armar el producto y el listing alrededor de esos terminos libres.
razones: El nucleo de ESTE producto son 83 keywords con 126,085 busquedas/mes (las del vocabulario del producto que ya se pelean varios competidores).
El lider (B0DZ1Y9LSJ) esta en pagina 1 del 73.7% de ese volumen: el nucleo ya tiene dueno.
Pero 35 terminos del producto (621,242 busquedas/mes, 65.6% del total) los rankean 2 competidores o menos: ahi no hay con quien pelear.
Otras 199,702 busquedas/mes del nicho son de temporada (Halloween): demanda real, pero concentrada en dos meses. No se cuenta como espacio libre del ano.
Y 777,348 busquedas/mes mas son de otros productos (el wall decor no compite ahi): warmers, moldes, disfraces. Esas no cuentan.
En las keywords prioritarias, 2.8 de los 9 competidores ya meten el termino en el titulo: para rankear ahi hay que escribir el titulo igual de fino.
overview.falta: Este veredicto lee demanda y reparto de keywords. NO incluye todavia precio, reseñas ni ventas reales por competidor (eso entra con Keepa + el review moat).
razones_en: The core of THIS product is 83 keywords worth 126,085 searches/month (the product's own vocabulary, already fought over by several competitors).
The leader (B0DZ1Y9LSJ) sits on page 1 for 73.7% of that volume: the core already has an owner.
But 35 of the product's terms (621,242 searches/month, 65.6% of the total) are ranked by 2 competitors or fewer: there is nobody to fight there.
Another 199,702 searches/month in the niche are seasonal (Halloween): real demand, but packed into two months. It does not count as year-round open space.
And 777,348 searches/month more belong to other products (the wall decor does not compete there): warmers, molds, costumes. Those do not count.
On the priority keywords, 2.8 of the 8 competitors already put the term in their title: ranking there means writing the title just as tight.
overview.lectura_en: The core of the niche already has an owner, but right beside it there is a large slice of demand nobody is fighting for. The way in is not the head keyword: it is building the product and the listing around those open terms.
overview.falta_en: This verdict reads demand and how the keywords are split. It does NOT yet include price, reviews or real sales per competitor (that comes with Keepa + the review moat).
